title: When the Vow Burns Anew
author: Freya Crane
blurb: Hazel Lockridge, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
